sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Qualifacts serves 2,700+ agencies across all 50 states. Describes three EHR platforms (CareLogic, Credible, InSync), AI documentation, billing services, telehealth.
ONC certification compliance page. Lists certification documents for CareLogic Enterprise S3 and other platforms. Primarily a document repository with Real World Testing plans/results.
CareLogic product page. Describes clinical documentation, treatment planning, scheduling, billing, ePrescribing, assessments, EVV, IDD/autism support, and CCBHC capabilities.
Company about page. Describes Qualifacts as largest behavioral health EHR in US, 25+ years experience. Differentiates CareLogic (enterprise), Credible (large/CCBHC), InSync (small/mid-size).
Client portal feature page. Details digital forms with eSignature, in-portal payments, appointment reminders, broadcast messaging, demographic data mapping, mobile app, and branded portal experience.
State compliance page. 88+ state reports, state-specific billing matrices, HIE integration, EVV, CCBHC support, MIPS/APM/VBR compliance across 25+ states.

Third-party EHR profile. Lists features including AI documentation (Qualifacts iQ), SOAP notes, eligibility/claims scrubbing, lab integration, document scanning, mobile apps, inpatient/residential support.

Third-party profile listing features: clinical documentation, treatment planning, billing/invoicing/AR, scheduling, patient portal, inpatient admission/discharge/bed tracking, compliance reporting, outcome tracking.

Software Advice profile. Referenced for feature overview and review aggregation. Page blocked (403) but search snippets confirmed intake, scheduling, treatment planning, ePrescribing, billing, analytics.

Capterra profile. Page blocked (403) but search results showed 4.0/5 rating, configurable software, key capabilities list including form builder, assessments, clinical decision support, billing, analytics.
August 2020 merger announcement. Warburg Pincus (Qualifacts) and Martis Capital (Credible) merged. Combined served 800+ agencies. Credible brought billing, analytics, telehealth.
December 2021 InSync acquisition. Doubled customer count, enabled service to 10M+ patients across all 50 states. Led to rebranding as Qualifacts.
Confirmed rebranding after InSync acquisition. Three platforms (CareLogic, Credible, InSync) under unified Qualifacts brand.

July 2014 Great Hill Partners investment. Described Qualifacts as largest SaaS EHR for behavioral health, serving 50,000+ professionals. Page content didn't load but details confirmed via search snippets.
Market share data source (referenced in search). Confirms CareLogic's presence in the EHR competitive landscape.
CareLogic EVV module login page. Confirms EVV is a distinct module with its own subdomain, supporting electronic visit verification for home/community-based services.
